author: bencos18
install_msg: Thank you for installing the Report cog. The bot owner can configure it globally with [p]reportset channel #channel, then members can reply to a message with [p]report <reason>.
description: Allows members in every server to report messages, including bot-generated memes and images, to one bot-owner-configured channel.
end_user_data_statement: This cog processes and forwards Discord user IDs, usernames, message content, attachment URLs, and report reasons to the bot owner's configured report channel. It does not persist this data.
